First tile in the accent colour. Rule: lists 40–80 ms, dense grids 20–40 ms, whole run within 600–800 ms. Params: each: cách nhau (30 ms) · duration mỗi ô (0.4 s) · from (start). Lists 0.04–0.08 s apart, dense grids 0.02–0.04 s; the whole run within 0.6–0.8 s.
